web_shell_startup.scope: Loading-screen startup paths only: packaged build via tools/serve_web.py reaches the menu; plain Godot export (editor Run in Browser layout, no release.json/game-pack.json) previously stuck at 0% with Download failed (404) and now boots stock index.pck to the menu; file:// shows serve instructions instead of Failed to fetch; second-tab Web Lock block and retry after owner close unchanged. Safari/Firefox, physical phones and the hosted URL were not re-tested. 0.2.3 adds named startup steps, a secure-context message and a 45-second stall notice with Try again; a deliberately unanswered pack part produced 'Downloading the game is taking too long' with Try again shown. 0.2.4: canvas sized to the visible viewport (Godot resize policy 0) and refitted after rotation; engine prepared before the pack download; pack parts written into one buffer; last startup step remembered across a tab crash. Emulated iPhone 13: 390x664 portrait -> 844x390 -> portrait canvas matches viewport at DPR3, no scroll, tap reaches Start; blocked pack part shows the remembered step on the next visit.

texture_memory.scope: Godot texture memory per screen at 390x844 on desktop software GL; not a physical phone measurement. Home and adventures remain above the 80 MB phone target; large backgrounds are drawn at or above source size on 4K and tablets.
